description:
This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice.
The Department of Veterans Affairs has a  Brand Name  Requirement for the following agricultural equipment:
1 EA; Unverferth Manufacturing 2755XL Seed Tender
1 EA; Bergman Manufacturing Agri-Speed Tractor Hitch
2 EA; Bergman Manufacturing Agri-Speed Wagon Hitch
Delivery of all items required within 10 Days of Award.
Requirement is being solicited as a Total Small Business Set-Aside
Solicitation will be posted immediately after.
